author: BernieSanders
text:
Does anyone think this is sane behavior?

No, Mr. Trump. In America, we don’t take loyalty oaths encouraging supporters “to cheat like hell” & do whatever it takes to keep your party in power even if they’re not registered to vote.

Stop acting like a mad king & a tinpot dictator. https://x.com/washingtonpost/status/2098464554703335554/video/1
